    x_oh[batch, feature, x_int] = 1
    return x_oh

title: Supervisor-ready conclusion

text: Flattened one-hot plus DMALA is compatible with tensor shapes, but it does not preserve categorical validity.
textPreview: Flattened one-hot plus DMALA is compatible with tensor shapes, but it does not preserve categorical validity.

text: Post-hoc argmax is a repair step, not a sampler guarantee.
textPreview: Post-hoc argmax is a repair step, not a sampler guarantee.

text: The CategoricalExample shows the better principle: sample class indices, then one-hot encode for model scoring.
textPreview: The CategoricalExample shows the better principle: sample class indices, then one-hot encode for model scoring.

text: For different cardinalities, padding must be paired with a validity mask in both forward and reverse proposals.
textPreview: For different cardinalities, padding must be paired with a validity mask in both forward and reverse proposals.

text: The generated output is safely decodable only if validity is maintained during sampling.
